content: In this section, we define SATA Tree-LSTM (Structure-Aware Tag Augmented Tree-LSTM, see Figure 2 ) which joins a tag-level tree-LSTM (section 3.2), a leaf-LSTM (section 3.3), and the original word tree-LSTM together.
